critical_feature_definition_caution: In selected72 the left outercap envelope includes a wrapping loose/windblown hair band. An inner anatomicallyrigid cap estimate around68rawpx versus85px outerhairwidth is plausible. These are different features, not conflicting exact bone measurements.
